name: Codan Limited
research_rationale: H1 communications guidance and the Zetron–Eventide deal support growth, but rich screen multiples and unverified Yahoo TTM cash leave the filing-backed case only partly aligned with the screen Buy.

weekly_updates.summary:
News since 6 Nov reiterates lifted H1 FY27 communications revenue (~US$400–410m) and Zetron’s planned Eventide acquisition; commentary mixes demand optimism with valuation caution.
27 Nov source refresh adds no new company filings; Yahoo quarterly cashflow is still empty, so screen TTM FCF remains unverified.
